question: Who owns this SOP, who approves revisions, on what review cycle?
why_it_matters: TBC is on an annual release cycle and each release has changed mobile mapping behaviour

question: Are GAMS and DMI fitted, and which mounting rack? (The configuration is answered: MX60 Premium.)
why_it_matters: GAMS decides whether GAMS-assisted initialization is available; DMI decides whether DMI settings appear in trajectory processing and whether the published no-outage accuracy applies; the rack decides whether the published GAMS corner offsets apply
source_evidence: TBC 22501; TBC 23888; MX60 UG Rev B p.12
resolution: Configuration answered 2026-09-19: MX60 Premium, the top configuration - panoramas 12288x6144 px, roll/pitch 0.0025 deg, the better 60 s outage figures. Stated by the system owner; serial-number confirmation outstanding under V-4. GAMS, DMI and rack remain open  |  2026-09-19 audit: the rack manual held in the repository is the MX Shock Absorbing Mounting Rack User Guide Rev B, P/N 37000001 (the 28 kg rack), while the spec sheet lists only the 18 kg standard rack. Circumstantial, not proof, but it points away from the standard rack - and the published GAMS corner offsets apply to the standard rack only. Settle by looking at the vehicle

question: Roles and authorities - who may operate, register, accept a registration, run Cleanup, sign the accuracy statement, own calibration currency
why_it_matters: The accepting person should not be the person who performed the adjustment

question: Do we hold a POSPac MMS 8.6+ licence, and where is it installed?
why_it_matters: Determines whether trajectory processing and PFIX are available at all, and removes one of three degraded-GNSS remedies

question: Is LiDAR QC a capability we intend to have?
why_it_matters: 128-256 GB RAM, dedicated SSDs, MATLAB Runtime. Urgent only when it is too late

question: Registration command selection - is Register a Mission the corridor default, and where does run-to-run sit?
why_it_matters: The three commands are not interchangeable. Run-to-run uses no control and propagates the reference run absolute error

question: What constitutes an acceptable registration and an acceptable point cloud?
why_it_matters: No Trimble source provides a threshold. Must combine residuals, independent checks, visual inspection and the project accuracy requirement

question: Is the control/check designation fixed before registration and unchangeable during it?
why_it_matters: Guards the failure that looks like diligence - a processor who dislikes a check residual and ticks the point into the adjustment

blocks: delivery for a stated accuracy purpose
question: Control design - how many control points, at what spacing, how many independent checks, and does density vary with predicted GNSS conditions?
why_it_matters: No Trimble source states any. TBC minimum of one pair is a mathematical floor. Local does not extrapolate

question: What is verified at import, and by whom?
why_it_matters: Seven checks, each cheaper now than later

question: IN-Fusion+ Single Base or PP-RTX?
why_it_matters: Determines whether a base station is occupied every mission, and the reference frame the solution is computed in

question: Which datum and epoch do we work in, who sets it, who checks it?
why_it_matters: A silent failure mode (the ITRF00 path) plus a user-settable epoch control Trimble flags as risky

question: Are scans generated coloured by default?
why_it_matters: Discovering later that colour was wanted means regenerating the mission

question: Where is the calibration site, and who maintains it?
why_it_matters: Establishing one is a morning of work; finding one under schedule pressure is not

question: Recalibration interval and triggers - does daily removal of the Sensor Unit count as disturbing it? What happens to data collected on a stale calibration?
why_it_matters: If the head comes off nightly, calibration is routine rather than periodic

question: QC inspection content - what does a visual point-cloud QC pass cover, and an imagery QC pass?
why_it_matters: Two QC layers produce no software artefact at all

question: Is the retro-reflective target check our periodic verification, and at what interval?
why_it_matters: The only independent check on the instrument in any source

question: The record package - what provenance record accompanies a deliverable, where does it live, and where is the control/check designation and its residuals recorded?
why_it_matters: Six facts cannot be reconstructed from the deliverable; TBC is not documented as reporting the designation

question: Is the imagery file-size scan adopted?
why_it_matters: Validation required first - file size alone cannot establish image validity

question: What is our position on imagery privacy? Are unblurred originals retained, and for how long?
why_it_matters: Legal and reputational dimensions outside the SOP. Blurring is irreversible in the delivered product

question: Handling segments mobile mapping cannot serve - the decision rule when a corridor produces an unacceptable trajectory, and whether marginal segments are recorded before mobilising
why_it_matters: Includes the legitimate professional answer that another method would be more defensible

question: When may Cleanup be performed, by whom, and what must be archived first?
why_it_matters: Destructive, not undoable, reduces registration history at the moment the project is handed on

question: The export release gate - is the pre-export trajectory-node confirmation mandatory, and may exports be made with Export timestamps enabled before T18 resolves?
why_it_matters: Registration does not reach the cloud until Update Scans runs; a documented export option may substitute reprocessed data

question: Deliverable specification - standard formats, which export path produces each, and default scaling
why_it_matters: Ground scaling does not record its own scale factor; grid writes a sidecar that does

question: What is the corridor continuity inspection method and coverage?
why_it_matters: Must detect a degraded stretch shorter than the sampling interval, which rules out sparse spot checks

question: How many passes, in what pattern, by roadway type?
why_it_matters: Two of three degraded-GNSS remedies require overlap collected on the day

question: Base station strategy and maximum baseline?
why_it_matters: Field logistics on every mission. Interacts with D-19

question: Field operating rules - wet-weather go/no-go with operator stand-down authority, night collection, collection speed by deliverable type, free-space margin
why_it_matters: An operator who must phone for permission will drive. Trimble publishes speed maxima and no relation to deliverable quality
source_evidence: MX60 UG Rev B p.49,53; TMR 9.1

question: Where are lever arms, the Vehicle Preset and the installation configuration recorded and verified?
why_it_matters: Entered once, used every mission. An error is systematic, invisible, and persists until someone re-measures
source_evidence: MX60 UG Rev B p.68; TBC 25943

question: Field close-out - what the mission field record contains, what coverage verification happens before leaving site, what triggers a re-drive and who decides
why_it_matters: No software produces the field record. Missed overlap removes office options irrecoverably

question: Offload, verification and backup procedure
why_it_matters: The only irreversible step in the workflow

question: Folder structure, naming and storage location
why_it_matters: Several provenance artefacts are small files loose in a project folder

question: Is a chain-of-custody record required?
why_it_matters: The deliverable may not be able to speak for itself

question: Capture and retention - what is retained, where, for how long, by whom, including Backup SBET Next to MXDB, Results of Scan Generation, and the calibration JSON
why_it_matters: Tier 1 is a few hundred kilobytes. Tier 3 is hundreds of GB and determines whether reprocessing is ever possible

question: Export the same registered run twice, timestamps off and on, and compare point geometry. Does reprocessing from raw reflect the registered trajectory?
why_it_matters: The highest-priority test. A documented export option may deliver data that was never the data that was checked

question: Does Cleanup delete sbet_*_reg_####.out from storage, or only remove the project objects?
why_it_matters: Determines what must be archived before Cleanup. Distinguish project object retention from underlying file retention

question: Establish the reliable export-state verification method for each export path
why_it_matters: How an export dialog resolves its selection is not documented

question: Does Reflective Panels remove legitimate retro-reflective returns from signs and line marking?
why_it_matters: On sign and retroreflectivity work those returns are the deliverable

question: Which registration type, when? Test Global, Local and Global-then-Local with independent checks
why_it_matters: No selection rule published. Global-then-Local gets no guidance and appears in every Trimble screenshot

question: Which feature types are fit for horizontal control, vertical control, or both, at MX60 density and incidence?
why_it_matters: Will shape control design more than any software setting

question: Filter selection and defaults - Default vs High Quality, Isolated Points default state, Range Max against useful range, Fog and Sun when conditions did not occur
why_it_matters: The largest block of untested settings. Trimble text contradicts itself on Isolated Points

question: Colouriser forward vs backward camera preference and its effect on fringing
why_it_matters: No selection rule given

question: Registration Auto-Saving default state
why_it_matters: Targets.csv is the registration field book and a wrong dialog answer empties it permanently

question: Target-Bundle Adjustment - test both states with independent checks
why_it_matters: Checking it makes the adjustment coarser, 250 m against 70 m; the name reads backwards

question: Which Parametrix coordinate systems does POSPac recognise directly, and which trigger the ITRF00 path?
why_it_matters: Answerable once, then known

question: Multipath default Medium on open-sky corridors
why_it_matters: Medium is described as being for degraded coverage

question: DMI scale factor SD default 5 percent - was the wheel actually measured?
why_it_matters: Trimble says set it to 100 percent if unknown

question: LiDAR QC settings - range default 3-100 m and Lasers = All
why_it_matters: The Lasers default contradicts the guidance printed beside it

question: Working cutting plane thickness for the visual checks
why_it_matters: Trimble screenshots show 0.030 and 5.000 with no basis. Too thick buries a real offset

question: Sample points random sampling in the classified LAS exporter
why_it_matters: A destructive thinning with no documented spatial rule; default state not stated

question: Which trajectory travels? Publish a registered run to TRCPS and export the same run to TMX, and inspect what arrives
why_it_matters: Both paths carry trajectory geometry; neither states which trajectory

question: Register a mission, run a Mission Report, and look. Does it contain the signed GCP residuals?
why_it_matters: The 2025.21 release note says residuals are in the report; the Mission Report topic does not mention them

question: Export a LAS and inspect the file directly - header fields, VLRs, sidecar contents
why_it_matters: Trimble topics do not enumerate LAS headers. Something undocumented may be written

question: Draw a Point Cloud tab selection across scans from two trajectories and observe
why_it_matters: Whether TBC warns, prevents or silently permits is not stated

question: How much run overlap is enough for run-to-run registration?
why_it_matters: Trimble states the requirement qualitatively only

question: Does exported imagery inherit or otherwise reflect a registration adjustment?
why_it_matters: Imagery is positioned from the trajectory; nothing states whether it is recomputed

question: What imagery streams actually exist on the MX60, and which are exposed through TBC export?
why_it_matters: The MX60 export tree shows no Planar cameras while the side-images option persists

question: Attempt both reconstruction paths - timestamp matching and trajectory geometry comparison - on a dataset with two candidate trajectories
why_it_matters: Neither has been attempted; both are the fallback if provenance is queried

question: When Export timestamps causes reprocessing from raw data, which trajectory is used?
why_it_matters: A direct yes/no question with the largest consequence in the workflow

question: Confirm the configuration from the serial number, and state whether GAMS and DMI are fitted and which rack is on the vehicle
why_it_matters: Confirms the owner's statement that this is a Premium, and answers the remainder of D-2. Imagery and accuracy commitments now rest on that statement until it is checked
resolution: Configuration stated by the system owner 2026-09-19 as MX60 Premium - not yet checked against the serial number. GAMS, DMI and rack still unanswered

question: Which trajectory do TMX export and Publish to TRCPS send when a run has both an imported and a registered trajectory?
why_it_matters: Both carry trajectory geometry; neither says which

question: Does any TBC export write the source trajectory into a LAS header, VLR or sidecar?
why_it_matters: The one provenance question documentation cannot answer

question: Does removing and refitting the Sensor Unit disturb the calibration? What symptoms indicate drift?
why_it_matters: Determines whether calibration is periodic or routine

question: Is the MX60 laser control presented as Measurement Prog plus Line Speed, or a combined Laser Mode? Which TMI version applies?
why_it_matters: The Quick Start Guide and TMI Rev L disagree - CONFLICT-005
source_evidence: MX60 QSG Rev B p.10; TMI UG Rev L p.29

question: Which TBC version is installed on our workstation?
why_it_matters: Two version-dependent behaviours, both legacy - 5.21 and 5.80 predate the oldest published release note

question: Accessory manuals not held - Trimble GAMS Antenna Kit and DMI Installation and Operation Manuals
why_it_matters: Needed for the lever-arm procedure if fitted. The DMI manual has the scale factor for the measured wheel diameter

question: Does the Lateral Range Limit affect accuracy, or is it purely a data-volume tool?
why_it_matters: Undocumented

question: What is the MX60 actual camera complement, and which streams are exposed through TBC export?
why_it_matters: Pairs with T27

question: Does LiDAR QC have its own POSPac dependency?
why_it_matters: Trimble does not state one but directs configuration questions to Applanix Support

question: Which report contains the signed GCP residuals added in TBC 2025.21?
why_it_matters: The only mobile mapping report topic does not mention residuals

question: Is the retro-reflective target check the recommended periodic verification for the MX60, and at what interval?
why_it_matters: Trimble says regularly and defines nothing

question: When should PFIX be preferred over registration?
why_it_matters: This document framing of the distinction is inferred, not stated by Trimble

question: Does the coordinate system without Geoid restriction on TMX export apply to the MX60, or only the MX9?
why_it_matters: Stated for the MX9 only

question: Scanner field of view - 346 degrees (UG p.54) or 360 degrees (spec sheet p.2)?
why_it_matters: Matters for occlusion geometry - CONFLICT-002
source_evidence: MX60 UG Rev B p.54; Spec sheet p.2

question: Does a predicted GNSS environment (almanac PDOP, canopy, urban canyon) correlate with achieved trajectory RMS on this system? Drive a route with a range of predicted conditions and compare the prediction against the RMS colouring afterwards.
why_it_matters: No Trimble source relates predicted GNSS conditions to achieved trajectory quality for the MX60. Establishing it would turn mission planning from judgement into estimate, and would let control density be set from the prediction rather than after the fact.
source_evidence: No source. MX60 UG Rev B p.56 publishes performance at no outage and at 60 s outage only

question: Does Parametrix adopt Trimble's documented initialization sequence, closing sequence and control-bracketing design rule as mandatory Parametrix requirements?
why_it_matters: Trimble documents these methods but does not state them as requirements - it writes 'should', 'it is advised', and 'Proposal of a checklist for system operation'. They carry TRIMBLE DOCUMENTED METHOD and 'should' until Parametrix decides. Nothing else makes them mandatory.
source_evidence: MX60 QSG Rev B sec 5.3 p.11, sec 5.5 p.13, sec 6 p.14; TBC 22905

question: Is the 30-minute minimum mission time enforced by TMI, and what is the reason for it?
why_it_matters: Trimble states it as a requirement in two places and gives no reason and no indication whether the software prevents a shorter mission. A crew that has to abandon a mission at 20 minutes needs to know whether the data is unusable or merely suboptimal.
source_evidence: MX60 QSG Rev B sec 5.4 p.13; sec 6 p.14

question: Run the TBC Boeing Bump Index report end to end on an MX60 dataset: what inputs does the command take, what does it output, and does the vertical quality of an ordinary run support an FAA profile?
why_it_matters: TBC ships the analysis under Mobile Mapping - Analysis - Boeing Bump Index and it is a sellable deliverable. Nobody here has run it. The open question is not whether the tool exists but whether our vertical trajectory supports the profile it computes from, which is answered by validating against pavement control, not by the nominal accuracy
source_evidence: TBC 29599; FAA AC 150/5380-9; nav tree capture sources/tbc-help-captures/_nav-tree-mobile-mapping.png

question: Work through the six TBC mobile mapping commands this document set does not cover: Run a Batch Command, Create CAD Entities on Mobile Mapping Data, Create Orthomosaics from a Back-Camera system, Import Ortho Lane Images, Inspect Pavement Condition, and Import and Export Road Segments in AgileAssets
why_it_matters: Every one appears in the TBC Mobile Mapping navigation tree and none is documented here. They are the downstream, product-making half of the module - the half that maps to sellable deliverables - so the set currently explains how to produce a registered point cloud and stops

question: Is airfield pavement roughness - Boeing Bump Index and IRI - a service Parametrix intends to offer, and if so what control and validation scheme proves the vertical?
why_it_matters: It is a real TBC capability and a strong differentiator, but an FAA-facing deliverable rests on the vertical trajectory rather than on instrument precision. The control scheme has to be agreed before collection, not after, and whether a given reviewing authority accepts a mobile-mapping-derived profile is a question to ask them
